import unittest
from textstats import tokenize, word_count, top_words, sentence_count, mean_word_length, char_histogram

class TestTextStats(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tokenize(self):
        text = "Hello world! How are you?"
        result = tokenize(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, ["hello", "world", "how", "are", "you"])
    
    def test_word_count(self):
        text = "Hello world! How are you?"
        result = word_count(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, 9)
    
    def test_top_words(self):
        text = "hello hello world world world how how how"
        result = top_words(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, [('world', 3), ('how', 3), ('hello', 2)])
    
    def test_sentence_count(self):
        text = "Hello world. How are you? I'm fine!"
        result = sentence_count(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, 4)
    
    def test_mean_word_length(self):
        text = "hello world"
        result = mean_word_length(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, 5.0)
    
    def test_char_histogram(self):
        text = "Hello world!"
        result = char_histogram(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, {'h': 1, 'e': 1, 'l': 3, 'o': 2, 'w': 1, 'r': 1, 'd': 1})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
EOF"}
